import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem radical_difference_eq_zero_iff_zero_or_one (b : ℕ) :
    Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) ^ 6) - ((b : ℝ) ^ 6) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) = 0 ↔ b = 0 ∨ b = 1 := by
  have hb : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (b : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg b
  have h1 : Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) ^ 6) = (b : ℝ) ^ 3 := by
    have : (b : ℝ) ^ 6 = ((b : ℝ) ^ 3) ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [this]
    exact Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)
  have h2 : ((b : ℝ) ^ 6) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) = (b : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    by_cases hb0 : b = 0
    · subst hb0
      simp
    · have hb_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hb0)
      have hcast : (b : ℝ) ^ 6 = (b : ℝ) ^ (6 : ℝ) := by norm_cast
      rw [hcast, ← Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt hb_pos)]
      have : (6 : ℝ) * ((1 : ℝ) / 3) = (2 : ℝ) := by norm_num
      rw [this]
      norm_cast
  rw [h1, h2]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h3 : (b : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((b : ℝ) - 1) = 0 := by
      calc (b : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((b : ℝ) - 1) = (b : ℝ) ^ 3 - (b : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = 0 := h
    cases mul_eq_zero.mp h3 with
    | inl hl =>
      left
      exact_mod_cast sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hl
    | inr hr =>
      right
      exact_mod_cast sub_eq_zero.mp hr
  · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> norm_num
